newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: MOZAMBIQUE RAISES FUEL PRICES BY UP TO 24 PCT.
newsitem.headline: MOZAMBIQUE RAISES FUEL PRICES BY UP TO 24 PCT.

text.p: Mozambique's Mineral Resources and Energy Ministry announced liquid fuel price increases of up to 24 percent on Monday.
Diesel fuel went up immediately from to 5,640 meticais per litre from 4,560 per litre (49.2 US cents per litre from 39.7 US cents) -- a rise of nearly 24 percent.
The new petrol price was set at 6,730 meticais per litre, up from 6,670 meticais, the ministry announced.
Jet fuel was pushed up nearly 17 percent to 3,813.6 meticais per litre from 3,262.8 and kerosene would sell for 3,580 meticais a litre -- 23 percent up from 2,910 previously.
The price of cooking gas remains unchanged at 6,545.5 meticais per kilogram.
All quoted prices were for fuel sold at the main port cities.
The inland price of fuel is slightly higher, with distributors allowed to recover transport costs.
The Mozambican government reviews fuel prices every quarter and increases them when imported fuel costs in meticais rise by over three percent. ($1=11,473 meticais)
